findings.title: Synthetic partial-withdrawal reward accounting gap
findings.root_cause: The partial withdrawal path reduces shares but does not reconcile reward debt before a later claim.
findings.security_claim: Reward debt must represent current shares and reward index after every permitted position mutation.
findings.violated_invariant_or_trust_assumption: reward_debt = f(shares, reward_index) at every claim boundary
findings.observable_consequence: synthetic claim amount differs from the reconciled reference calculation
findings.impact: incorrect reward accounting in the synthetic fixture
findings.verification_method: deterministic invariant replay and complete internal-call trace

falsification_result.notes: The full-withdrawal control reconciles correctly; the partial path does not.

findings.fix_guidance: Reconcile reward debt on every share mutation before claims become reachable.
findings.coverage_impact: partial withdrawal covered; upgrade migration remains blocked
